build.allocationPolicy: All upstream C translation units substitute malloc/calloc/realloc/free after libc declarations. Each live block charges its exact anonymous mmap length rounded to 16 KiB including its aligned header, plus 64 bytes per block, before mapping. mmap/munmap avoid unbounded malloc-cache reuse. Runtime OS pages must divide 16 KiB. Realloc charges both old and new until copy/free. Calls are serialized; the cap belongs to one decoder lifetime. External input/output, the 64 KiB stack input chunk, kernel mapping metadata and process/runtime memory require separate accounting. Color conversion has a separate 96 KiB stack scratch buffer and fixed-profile CMM allocation reserve.
